name: lib/net
description: Opens TCP connections and transfers bytes with explicit connection lifetimes.
readme: Opens TCP connections and transfers bytes with explicit connection lifetimes.
Import this module with use net.

files.content:
-- Opens TCP connections and transfers bytes with explicit connection lifetimes.
public define Connection as opaque.
public use "net" function connect(host text, port unsigned) giving failable pointer to Connection.
public use "net" function listen(host text, port unsigned) giving failable pointer to Connection.
public use "net" function accept(listener pointer to Connection) giving failable pointer to Connection.
public use "net" function port(listener pointer to Connection) giving failable unsigned.
-- Borrows the platform's native socket. It is valid only while the connection stays open.
public use "net" function handle(connection pointer to Connection) giving failable unsigned.
public use "net" function send(connection pointer to Connection, content text) giving failable unsigned.
public use "net" function receive(connection pointer to Connection, size unsigned) giving failable text.
-- Advanced socket controls. push may write fewer bytes than requested.
public use "net" function push(connection pointer to Connection, content text) giving failable unsigned.
public use "net" function shutdown(connection pointer to Connection, direction text) giving failable nothing.
public use "net" function nodelay(connection pointer to Connection, enabled boolean) giving failable nothing.
public use "net" function keepalive(connection pointer to Connection, enabled boolean) giving failable nothing.
public use "net" function close(connection pointer to Connection) giving failable nothing.
